strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Routes terminal controlled child evidence back into the completed parent task through the existing parent join continuation path.
Allows a headless caller to continue a parent orchestration task without leaving headless.continue_once for a manual task.run call.
Requires Rust runtime validation of explicit authorization, parent identity, current child completion fingerprint, terminal child counts, and unconsumed parent join admission.
Records only bounded continuation metadata and replays by continuation_id without duplicating parent join consumption or task execution events.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances subtask_orchestration with supporting headless_autonomous_development, runtime_permission_enforcement, persistent_structured_ledger, and progress_visualization.
answers.new_capability: headless.continue_once can run one completed parent join continuation using explicit parent and child completion evidence.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Direct task.run can admit a completed parent join, but headless.continue_once normal selection excludes Completed parents and previously returned a run_parent_task_explicitly boundary.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless subtask workflows stall after controlled children reach terminal states and require manual task.run outside the continuation ledger.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M30-M32 focused verifier diagnostics, context reads, and recovery task continuation; this phase routes parent/child orchestration join continuation.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The implementation extends existing headless.continue_once params and delegates execution to existing task.run.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It reuses existing TaskRunResult, progress overview, and next route structures with metadata-only decision evidence.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime validates a parent join target, executes the completed parent through task.run, records bounded continuation evidence, and replays without rerun.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can bridge terminal controlled child outcomes back into the parent task with replay-safe routing.
answers.milestone_progress: This is the core M33 vertical slice and should make the milestone closeout-eligible after CI and review.

exit_criteria: headless.continue_once accepts parent_join_run_target only with explicit authorization and fresh progress evidence.
The runtime rejects parent join targets combined with context budget multi-step mode or unrelated recovery, apply, retry, provider, and context-read fields.
The runtime delegates successful parent join execution to existing task.run parent join admission and execution.
Successful continuation records metadata-only HeadlessContinuationDecisionRecorded evidence and returns bounded task_run_result, post-progress, and next-route data.

Replay of the same continuation_id returns the persisted bounded result without rerunning the parent or duplicating TaskRunning, ParentJoinContinuationFingerprintConsumed, terminal, or decision events.
VSIX protocol validation accepts valid parent_join_run_target params and rejects invalid authorization, fingerprints, counts, or raw fields.
No new RPC, report, digest, history, readiness, preview, capability, or inspection wrapper is added.

next_phase_candidate_notes: After M33.1 lands, close out M33 if review confirms the parent join route is end-to-end and replay-safe. Reject additional parent/child reports, histories, readiness wrappers, or inspection-only surfaces.
